FAQ

Common questions

Is LinkedIn automation safe? ▾
We use safe automation practices within LinkedIn’s limits — typically 25–50 connection requests per day. We’ve never had a client account restricted using our approach.
Do I need LinkedIn Premium or Sales Navigator? ▾
Sales Navigator is recommended for the best targeting — it’s ~$100/month. We can work without it using free search, but results are better with it.
What industries work best for LinkedIn outreach? ▾
B2B professional services, SaaS, financial services, healthcare vendors, and consulting. If you’re selling to business owners, C-suite, VPs, or managers, LinkedIn is a high-leverage channel.
How long does it take to see results? ▾
First connections within 24 hours of launch. Replies typically start in week 2. Warm meetings usually begin by week 4–6.
Can I see the messages before they go out? ▾
Yes — you approve all messaging before we launch. You own your brand voice, we just make it scale.
